company: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. Class A Common Stock

risks: Substantially all of our cash and cash equivalent balances held at financial institutions exceeded deposit insured limits as of September 30, 2025.
The offering will result in substantial dilution for existing shareholders.
We may be unable to raise additional capital needed to grow our business.
We generate a large portion of our revenue from a small number of customers, and losing one could materially affect our operating results.
The company can redeem Public Warrants at $0.01 per warrant if certain conditions are met, potentially making them worthless.

growth_drivers: SharonAI is one of Australia's leading Neoclouds, focusing on specialized, high-performance compute for AI, machine learning, and HPC.
The Company announced a potential $200 million investment from Digital Alpha and a strategic partnership with Cisco.
$1,209 thousand in total revenue from GPU cloud computing operations, up from $172 thousand year-over-year.
SharonAI is a certified NVIDIA Cloud Partner, one of only 3 in the Australian market.
SharonAI has partnerships with World Wide Technology, Lenovo, VAST, Megaport, and Dicker Data, supporting its growth in cloud computing and AI.
risks: The decrease in fair value of digital assets reduced reported earnings and may affect short-term financial flexibility.
SharonAI has significant off-balance sheet commitments, including data center colocation and managed service agreements, which impact future cash flows.
The cost of power and the availability of GPU/CPU/storage are key factors affecting profitability.
Supply chain limitations and geopolitical restrictions drive longer lead times and increased costs for GPU hardware.
Non-compliance with regulations could result in significant penalties and harm the business.

growth_drivers: SharonAI entered into an agreement with Nvidia to deploy 72MW AI factory and up to 40,000 Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs in Australia.
Revenue increased by $1,554 thousand, or approximately 412%, due to new customers onboarded during Q2 2026.
Total revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $2,225 thousand, up from $702 thousand in 2025.
The market for GPU Cloud services shows strong theoretical demand, with significant interest from AI developers and enterprises.
risks: The company recognized a loss of $6,139 thousand from the change in fair value of warrant liabilities.
The company recognized a loss of $400,441 thousand from the change in fair value of convertible notes.
SharonAI's colocation and managed service agreements represent significant future financial obligations.
Vendor pricing changes and service disruptions could impact the cost-effectiveness of managed service agreements.

growth_drivers: SharonAI Holdings Inc. provides sovereign, low-latency access to advanced accelerated computing hardware, including NVIDIA's B200, B300 and GB300 GPUs.
The market for GPU Cloud services has shown strong theoretical demand, with significant interest from AI developers and enterprises.
risks: The Company's obligations under these contracts include ongoing infrastructure support, equipment maintenance, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
The fair value of stock-based awards is measured at the grant date and recognized as expense over the requisite service period.

growth_drivers: SharonAI has upgraded its total secured AI factory capacity to 212 megawatts, an increase of 80 megawatts from the previous guidance.
The contracted book has grown by roughly 4x and our secured capacity has more than doubled since.
SharonAI Holdings secured an additional 80 megawatts in Australia, increasing its total secured AI factory capacity to 212 megawatts.
SharonAI Holdings secured 212 megawatts of capacity for deployment by the end of 2027.
risks: NVIDIA provides a six-year anchor commitment with guaranteed minimum revenue, derisking the capital investment.

growth_drivers: AI natives are securing future capacity, forecasting strong demand.
$1.32 billion contract for 10 petabytes of storage shows material upgrade.
Early demand for Vera Rubin secured for late '27, early '28.
SharonAI Holdings is contracting at a faster rate with high-quality customers.
64,000 GPUs to be delivered by mid-2027, supporting growth.
risks: Dependence on high-quality customers could limit growth if they face issues.
Relying on take-or-pay basis for 3-5 years could lock in revenue but limit flexibility.
